description: Paper 3 Regime C – explicit RVE (G4MultiUnion), minimal feasible geometry for ternary HDPE/Bi2O3/WO3. 250-nm RVE (N~24 Bi2O3 spheres, r=25 nm) at phi_Bi2O3=0.10 in the full ternary effective medium (rho_eff=2.366 g/cm3). Bi2O3 spheres are used as the explicit filler; WO3 phase is absorbed into the effective medium. L/r = 10 satisfies minimum RVE criterion. Dual K-edges: Bi at 90.526 keV and W at 69.525 keV. 10M histories/point.
